prose_placements.source_text: THEORETICAL COMPETITION
prose_placements.text: 이론시험

prose_placements.source_text: January 13, 2010
Please read this first:
prose_placements.text: 먼저 읽으시오:

prose_placements.source_text: The time available for the theoretical competition is 4 hours. There are three questions.
prose_placements.text: 이론시험의 제한 시간은 4시간이며, 문제는 세 문항이다.

prose_placements.source_text: Use only the pen provided.
prose_placements.text: 제공된 펜만 쓰시오.

prose_placements.source_text: You can use your own calculator for numerical calculations. If you don’t have one, please
prose_placements.text: 수치 계산에는 자신의 계산기를 사용할 수 있다. 계산기가 없다면

prose_placements.source_text: ask for it from Olympiad organizers.
prose_placements.text: 대회 운영진에게 요청하시오.

prose_placements.source_text: You are provided with Writing sheet and additional paper. You can use the additional paper
prose_placements.text: 답안용지와 여분의 종이가 제공된다. 여분의 종이는 연습용으로 쓸 수 있다.

prose_placements.source_text: for drafts of your solutions but these papers will not be checked. Your final solutions which
prose_placements.text: 여분의 종이는 채점하지 않는다. 채점받을 최종 풀이는 반드시

prose_placements.source_text: will be evaluated should be on the Writing sheets. Please use as little text as possible. You
prose_placements.text: 답안용지에 작성하시오. 문장은 가능한 한 적게 쓰고

prose_placements.source_text: should mostly use equations, numbers, figures and plots.
prose_placements.text: 주로 수식, 수치, 그림과 그래프를 쓰시오.

prose_placements.source_text: Use only the front side of Writing sheets. Write only inside the bordered area.
prose_placements.text: 답안용지의 앞면만 사용하고, 테두리 안쪽에만 작성하시오.

prose_placements.source_text: Begin each question on a separate sheet.
prose_placements.text: 문제마다 새 답안지에서 시작하시오.

prose_placements.source_text: Fill the boxes at the top of each sheet of paper with your country (Country), your student
prose_placements.text: 각 용지 위쪽의 칸에 국가명(Country), 참가자 코드(Student Code),

prose_placements.source_text: code (Student Code), the question number (Question Number), the progressive number of
prose_placements.text: 문제 번호(Question Number), 각 용지의 쪽 번호(Page Number),

prose_placements.source_text: each sheet (Page Number), and the total number of Writing sheets used (Total Number of
prose_placements.text: 사용한 답안용지의 총 쪽 수(Total Number of Pages)를 기입하시오.

prose_placements.source_text: Pages). If you use some blank Writing sheets for notes that you do not wish to be evaluated,
prose_placements.text: 빈 답안용지를 채점받지 않을 메모용으로 썼다면,

prose_placements.source_text: put a large X across the entire sheet and do not include it in your numbering.
prose_placements.text: 용지 전체에 큰 X표를 하고 쪽 번호에서 제외하시오.

prose_placements.source_text: At the end of the exam, arrange all sheets for each problem in the following order:
prose_placements.text: 시험이 끝나면 각 문제의 답안지를 다음 순서로 정리하시오:

prose_placements.source_text: Used Writing sheets in order;
prose_placements.text: 쓴 답안용지를 순서대로;

prose_placements.source_text: The sheets you do not wish to be evaluated
prose_placements.text: 채점받지 않을 답안지

prose_placements.source_text: Unused sheets and the printed question.
prose_placements.text: 사용하지 않은 용지와 문제지.

prose_placements.source_text: Place the papers inside the envelope and leave everything on your desk. You are not allowed
prose_placements.text: 용지를 봉투에 넣고 모든 자료를 책상 위에 놓으시오. 어떤 종이도

prose_placements.source_text: to take any paper out of the room.
prose_placements.text: 시험실 밖으로 가져갈 수 없다.
